insurer: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: Optional upgrade to Any Room available for SI ≥ ₹10L; downgrade to Shared Accommodation also optional

icu.note: No separate cap; ICU charges covered up to SI

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the policy wording

sub_limits.display: New Born (10% of SI, max ₹2L); Home Care (10% of SI, max ₹5L); Air Ambulance (10% of SI)
sub_limits.note: New Born Baby capped at 10% of SI (max ₹2L); Home Care Treatment capped at 10% of SI (max ₹5L); Air Ambulance 10% of SI. Core hospitalisation, AYUSH, modern treatments, day care all up to full SI.

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible in the base plan

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents

ped_waiting.note: Reducible to 24 or 12 months via optional paid add-on (first purchase only, subject to underwriter approval)

specific_disease_waiting.note: Applies to listed conditions: cataract, ENT, thyroid, hernia, joint replacement, gallbladder/kidney stones, gynaec diseases, prostate, varicose veins, transplants, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses are excluded under Code Excl 18; ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 50% of SI per claim-free year, max 100% of SI inbuilt. Optional Cumulative Bonus Booster (SI ≥ ₹10L) raises max to 600%.

restoration.note: Inbuilt: automatic restoration once by 100% upon partial/full utilisation; usable for same or different illness in subsequent hospitalisation. Optional Unlimited Restoration add-on available for unlimited restorations up to 100% each time.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days prior to admission

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 180 days after discharge

day_care.note: All day-care procedures covered up to sum insured

domiciliary.note: Covered for treatment exceeding 3 days; excludes asthma, bronchitis, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, psychiatric disorders and several other listed conditions

ayush.note: Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy covered up to SI in AYUSH hospitals; Yoga and Naturopathy excluded

organ_donor.note: Organ donor expenses not explicitly mentioned in the policy wording

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to SI per policy period; air ambulance up to 10% of SI per policy year

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, intra vitreal injections, etc.) covered up to SI

consumables.note: 68 non-medical consumable items (List I) covered only if Optional Cover Section III-4 is purchased; excluded by default (Code Excl 37)

global_cover.note: Territorial limit restricts all treatment to India only

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim contestable except on grounds of fraud

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; apply at least 30 days before renewal

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, yoga/naturopathy, circumcision, congenital external defects, chelation/EECP/hyperbaric O2 therapies, PRP injections, biologicals (outpatient)

optional_riders.display: Cumulative Bonus Booster (up to 600%), Any Room upgrade, PED waiting reduction (36→24/12mo), Consumables cover, Unlimited Restoration
